notes: Brand evidence is a 0-100 evidence grade based on pricing, repeat behavior, full-price selling, or traffic.
Margin fields use adjusted EBITDA margin for corporate models and restaurant-level margin for restaurant models.
Sales multiples are approximate market-cap-to-forward-or-run-rate-sales values, so they are screening inputs, not valuations.

candidates.name: FIGS
candidates.evidence: Active customers +12.2%, revenue/customer +5.8%, AOV +4.2%, international revenue +49.9%, gross margin 67.7%.

candidates.name: Birkenstock
candidates.evidence: Constant-currency sales +14%, DTC +12%, APAC +30%, adjusted EBITDA margin 32.1%; tariffs and FX compressed gross margin.

candidates.name: On Holding
candidates.evidence: Constant-currency sales +26.4%, DTC +28.7%, APAC +61.4%, gross margin 64.2%, adjusted EBITDA margin 21.0%.

candidates.name: Amer Sports
candidates.evidence: Revenue +32%, Arc'teryx technical apparel +33% with omni-comp +19%, Salomon-led outdoor performance +42%.

candidates.name: e.l.f. Beauty
candidates.evidence: FY2026 sales +25%, gross margin 71%, adjusted EBITDA margin 20%; rhode acquisition increased debt and integration risk.

candidates.name: CAVA
candidates.evidence: Revenue +32.2%, same-restaurant sales +9.7% with traffic +6.8%, units +20.2%, restaurant-level margin 25.1%; PE about 122x.

candidates.name: Dutch Bros
candidates.evidence: Revenue +30.8%, same-shop sales +8.3%, transactions +5.1%, shops +16.3%, rewards penetration 74%; PE about 103x.

candidates.name: YETI
candidates.evidence: Sales +8%, wholesale +19%, international +9%, gross margin 55.3%; DTC was flat and tariffs reduced margins.

candidates.name: Warby Parker
candidates.evidence: Revenue +8.3%, active customers +4.8%, revenue/customer +6.9%, 337 stores with 50 planned openings; gross margin fell to 54.0%.

candidates.name: Kura Sushi USA
candidates.evidence: Sales +16.1% and unit growth above 20%, but comparable sales -0.4%, traffic -5.1%, and operating profit near zero.

candidates.name: ODDITY Tech
candidates.evidence: Q1 revenue -26%, AOV down low single digits, adjusted EBITDA negative, and Q2 revenue guidance calls for a 25-30% decline.
